Acknowledgement of Country

We proudly acknowledge the First Peoples of Victoria. We acknowledge their ongoing strength in practising the world’s oldest living culture. We acknowledge the Traditional Owners’ lands, waters, and skies on which we live and pay respects to their Elders past and present. 

Inclusivity

We celebrate, value and include people of all backgrounds, genders, sexualities, cultures, bodies and abilities.
